Weather Forecasts

Learning Centre

Want to know how weather forecasts are made, how to tell your stratus cloud from your cirrus, or what an anticyclone is? You’ve come to the right place.

We are building a library of weather knowledge covering everything from thunderstorms to computer models. We’ll be adding to this learning centre over the coming months so if you’ve got a weather question or a meteorological mystery you want solved send your question to weather@metservice.com
